decisions.reason: It is very close to the firm's core dosimetry and QA expertise, remained prominently featured, and the firm's strong R&D base makes learning and incremental improvement highly likely.

This software extends the firm's established oncology QA workflow capabilities, fits its integration and automation direction, and benefits from the firm's substantial internal and collaborative knowledge base.
The CT image quality test phantom builds on existing medical imaging QA competencies, so the firm is well placed to interpret market feedback and refine it commercially.

Because this mammography phantom is more distant from the firm's established knowledge base, management is less able to assimilate early lessons and is more likely to reallocate resources to stronger core lines.

This full field mammography test phantom is likewise distant from the firm's core offer and appears easier to prune in favor of products where the firm's absorptive capacity and service advantages are stronger.
Medical imaging QA instruments are aligned with the firm's stated strategic direction and existing capabilities, making continued development and retention more likely than exit.
